A skeletal warrior in heavy, rusted iron plating with a tattered, charcoal grey cape. The face is a bleached white skull recessed deep within a blackened steel helm. The build is towering and imposing, wielding a massive, jagged greatsword. The creature features a long, bony spinal column visible through gaps in the armor and four sharp claws on each gauntlet.
BODY COLOR: bleached white and rusted iron
